verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a banking-as-a-service platform that stores customer PII, so the axis applies. The evidence covers creating and managing customers, accounts, cards, payments, verification and webhooks, but nothing documents retention policies, data deletion or erasure controls. Generic 'manages records' wording does not establish deletion or retention capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
